newsitem.title: FRANCE: Adacte to oppose Eurotunnel debt restructure.
newsitem.headline: Adacte to oppose Eurotunnel debt restructure.

text.p: Eurotunnel small shareholders' group Adacte is maintaining its opposition to a proposed debt restructuring plan for the Channel Tunnel operator, a spokeswoman for the group said on Thursday.
Adacte holds some 12 million proxy shareholder votes, she said. There are a total of 920 million voting shares in Eurotunnel.
Earlier, Christian Cambier, head of the Eurotunnel Shareholders' Association which also represents small shareholders, said he would support the debt restructuring.
Shareholders were to vote on the debt restructuring later on Thursday.
